milestones.label: University of Luxembourg closing date - set per programme
milestones.note: Each programme publishes its own. In 2026 Computer Science closed on 15 July for EU applicants and 24 March for non-EU applicants. Check your programme's admissions page.

milestones.note: If the 2027 EU window matches 2026, some University of Luxembourg programmes are still open when results arrive.
